name: Music Assistant
description: Music library manager and streaming server that plays to Sonos, AirPlay, Chromecast, Squeezebox, DLNA and more from one interface.

envVars.description: Timezone for container logs and scheduled tasks
Log verbosity: debug, info, warning or error

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    cap_add:
      - SYS_ADMIN
      - DAC_READ_SEARCH
    security_opt:
      - apparmor:unconfined
{{volumes}}
{{environment}}
